summary: Iter 96 chat-mode refactor (conversational default vs coach vs agent) verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/7 pytest passing (1 transient 503 on /api/chat/sessions that recovered on manual retry — not a code bug). Frontend: default /chat renders plain conversational bubbles with NO structured headers, coach-mode toggle activates and next reply shows full LEADERSHIP-ERKENNTNIS/STRATEGIE/NÄCHSTE SCHRITTE cards + follow-up chips, agent-mode also structured, FAB drawer on /dashboard sends and renders conversational text (not blank). Multi-turn history preserved (session_id stable, parsed.text stored per assistant message).

minor.issue: One transient 503 during test run; manual curl 1s later returned 200 with full list. Likely CDN/ingress blip, not code.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/chat.py L378: structured=(mode=='coach') or (agent and agent!='auto') — clean, matches spec.
routes/chat.py L409-419: defensive JSON-unwrap when model slips into JSON in conversational mode is good — prevents raw JSON leakage to UI.
Chat E2E latency: gpt-5.2 branch for msgs>180 chars can exceed 20s; UI tests wait 22s which is tight but sufficient. Consider a streaming UX in future.
GSI Google client_id origin warning in console ('The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID') — unrelated to this iteration but should be added for preview domain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat mode field is now first-class. Default = conversational (response.response = {text: '...'}); mode='coach' or agent set = structured (insight/strategy/action_steps/follow_up_questions/tasks). Frontend toggles: data-testid='coach-mode-toggle' (ChatInputBar). ChatMessage.js renders parsed.text as SmartText bubble. History endpoint returns parsed dict per message — assertion covered. If retesting: use existing test_iter96_chat_modes.py; expect 20-30s AI latency for gpt-5.2 branch (>180 char messages).
